comment: I'm sure she's a great person but unfortunately an ineffective teacher. Expects everyone to become Civ Pro experts overnight, even if she says she doesn't, and refuses to explain content in simpler terms. Constant book quotes/convoluted language that feels intended to confuse you and make you think things are a lot tougher than they really are.

Civil Procedure is a hard course in general so having a great professor is key. Harbach is not only very knowledgeable on the topic, but she presents information in a way that really helps you to understand it. You need to come to class prepared or you will get confused. Overall she really cares about the subject and her students!

She makes it clear that its not going to be a breeze. Harbach is AMAZING, she's sweet, understanding, CARES about her students, and a great sense of humor. Brings her everyday life into class in a way that HELPS illustrate the topic. LOVES repeat students, calls those who take all 3 of her upper level classes "Harbach Triples"

CivPro is hard and not really interesting. However, Harbach is really smart and wants you to succeed. Loves office hours. Offers advice on law school and exams. Cold calls. Pretty intense in class. Exam was 8hours. Ungraded midterm. Her kids are cute.

A wonderful professor. Civ pro is not an easy (or interesting) class,but professor Harbach will do everything in her power to help you and make sure you understand the material. She uses the socratic method. We had an ungraded midterm and a final that counted for 100% of our grade.
